description: Lander mode, extended AFTER the default preset: github>taslabs-net/renovate-config:lander. Renovate stops merging anything itself (no platform auto-merge, no branch merge), so hf-lander (homeflare-ct100 src/lander) is the one merge path. Eligibility does not change: default.json still sets the lander:eligible or hold label beside every automerge decision, and keepUpdatedLabel still rebases eligible pulls when they fall behind. Rendered into a repository's renovate.json by @homeflare/config only when its repo-shape says the lander lands it, which must follow that repository joining the lander's LIVE_REPOS, or nothing lands there.

packageRules.description: Last rule wins: every update type, whatever a default.json rule set, is proposed and labelled but never merged by Renovate.
